headline: L'Oreal Shares Jump After Q3 Sales Beat Estimates
summary: L'Oreal shares rose following the release of third-quarter sales figures that surpassed consensus analyst estimates. The revenue beat signaled resilient demand across the company's beauty portfolio.
why: L'Oreal is the world's largest cosmetics company, providing critical insights into consumer spending habits within the global personal care and beauty sector.

impacts.name: L'Oreal SA
impacts.why: Exceeding quarterly sales estimates builds investor confidence in management execution and earnings growth.

why_moved: Investors bid up the stock after top-line revenue metrics outperformed consensus estimates, easing concerns about slowing consumer spending.
